thought.text: The token expired. Let me refresh it and configure the client.

reasoning_content: Token expired. Let's re-fetch the token and continue with the client settings.

action.command: cd /tmp && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "client_id=admin-cli" -d "grant_type=password" -d "username=admin" -d "password=admin" -o kc-token.json && jq -r .access_token kc-token.json > kc-token.txt && TOKEN=$(cat kc-token.txt) && CLIENT_ID=$(cat client_id.txt) && echo "refreshed, client_id=$CLIENT_ID" && curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$CLIENT_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq '{clientId, redirectUris, webOrigins, standardFlowEnabled, directAccessGrantsEnabled, implicitFlowEnabled, serviceAccountsEnabled, publicClient, rootUrl, adminUrl}'
